# GPUI Kit icons

These SVG files are copied unchanged from `gpui-kit-assets` 0.6.0. They embed the icons used by GPUI Omarchy in WebAssembly builds; native builds continue to use `gpui-kit-assets` directly.

Upstream: https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/tree/main/crates/assets/assets/icons

The upstream icons originate from Lucide and are distributed under the ISC license. See `LICENSE`. GPUI Kit itself is licensed under Apache 2.0; its license is retained in `LICENSE-APACHE`.
